incidents.name: Bamboo spot-price manipulation
incidents.notes: The Bamboo contract prices its payout from the live pair reserves it reads, so moving that price with borrowed liquidity let the attacker withdraw more WBNB than deposited.

sources.ref: onchain review: Bamboo 0xed56784bc8f2c036f6b0d8e04cb83c253e4a6a94 created 2023-06-17T14:36:39Z by 0x0afdb87594acd4ec6fe68b81772c093b74a6143c, unrelated to attack sender 0x00703face6621bd207d3b4ac9867058190c0bb09; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. This transaction netted 11.9135 WBNB to the attack contract and the attack was repeated; lossUsd converts the ~200 BNB reported for the incident: 200 BNB x $245.64 at incidentTimestamp 1688472389 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $49,128. Boundary row: the victim behaved as coded and the attacker moved the price it read.
